detail.title: GS340 Pro 2.1 Bluetooth Gaming Speakers with RGB - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GS340 Pro pairs a punchy 5W subwoofer with dual 3W satellite speakers for a balanced 2.1 channel setup that fills a desk or room with clear highs and deep, rounded bass. Wireless Bluetooth streaming sits alongside a wired 3.5mm AUX input, so you can switch between phone, PC, laptop or tablet without swapping cables. Seven RGB lighting modes cycle across the subwoofer and satellites, letting you match the glow to your setup or mood, while the in-line volume control keeps loudness within easy reach during gameplay or movie marathons. USB powered and simple to set up, it's a compact multimedia speaker system built for everyday desktop use.
